name: @basementstudio/shader-lab-mcp

tools.name: add_layer
tools.description: Add a new layer. Without insertIndex it goes to index 0 (top of the stack — applied last, so an effect added there transforms everything below it). The new layer is returned with its default params and becomes selected.

insertIndex.description: Position in the stack; omit for index 0 (top)

tools.name: add_media_layer
tools.description: Create an image or video layer from a local file path (read on this machine) or base64 data. The asset is loaded into the editor and attached to a new layer of the matching type.

base64.description: Raw media bytes as base64 (alternative to path)

fileName.description: File name with extension; required with base64, inferred from path

insertIndex.description: Position in the stack; omit for index 0 (top)

path.description: Absolute path to an image or video on this machine (png, jpg, webp, gif, svg, mp4, webm, mov)

tools.name: describe_layer_type
tools.description: Get the full parameter schema for a layer type: keys, value types, ranges, step, select options, and defaults. Call this before update_layer_params so values land in range.

tools.name: duplicate_layer
tools.description: Duplicate a layer (copy is inserted right after the source layer).

tools.name: get_custom_shader
tools.description: Get the current source code, mode, and runtime error state of a custom shader layer.

tools.name: get_layer
tools.description: Get one layer with its full parameter values (including custom shader source).

tools.name: get_project_state
tools.description: Get the current editor state: composition size, the layer stack, and the selected layer. Layers stack like Photoshop: index 0 is the top of the sidebar (applied last), the highest index is the base/background. Layer params are omitted here; use get_layer for full params.

tools.name: get_shader_api_reference
tools.description: The custom shader API reference. Without a section: the shader contract plus a grouped index of every global (house utils + three/tsl). With a section (noise, color, patterns, sdf, complex, math, tsl-core, examples): full util sources or the complete TSL export list.

section.description: Section to expand; omit for the overview

tools.name: list_layer_types
tools.description: List every layer type that can be added (sources generate imagery, effects transform the layers below them, model renders 3D). Use describe_layer_type for a type's parameters.

tools.name: remove_layers
tools.description: Remove one or more layers by id.

tools.name: reorder_layer
tools.description: Move a layer to a new index in the stack. Remember: index 0 is the top (applied last), the highest index is the base — effects only affect layers below them (higher indices).

tools.name: reset_layer_params
tools.description: Reset all of a layer's parameters to their defaults.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Render the current composition to a PNG and return it as an image. Use this to see the result of your changes. Renders through the export pipeline (deterministic, full quality) at the current timeline time unless `time` is given.

time.description: Timeline time in seconds (default: current time)

tools.name: select_layer
tools.description: Select a layer in the editor UI (or pass no id to clear the selection). Useful to show the user what you are working on.

tools.name: update_layer_params
tools.description: Update effect parameters on a layer. Values are validated against the layer's schema: out-of-range numbers are clamped (and reported), unknown keys and wrong types are rejected with reasons. The response lists applied/clamped/rejected keys plus the resulting layer.

tools.name: update_layer
tools.description: Update layer-level properties: opacity (0-1), hue (-180 to 180), saturation (0-2), blendMode, compositeMode, and maskConfig. For effect-specific parameters use update_layer_params.

tools.name: write_custom_shader
tools.description: Write TSL source code into a custom shader layer and wait for the compile result. Omit layerId to create a new custom shader layer. Returns { compiled, error } — on failure, `error` is the exact compiler/runtime message, so fix and retry. Read get_shader_api_reference before writing your first shader: no imports allowed, export a named `sketch` via `export const sketch = Fn(() => ...)` returning a TSL node. Set effectMode true to transform the layers below (sample with `inputTexture.sample(...)`), false/omit to generate imagery from scratch.

effectMode.description: true: transform the layer stack below via inputTexture; false: generate from scratch

layerId.description: Existing custom shader layer id; omit to create one

instructions:
Drives a running Shader Lab editor tab: create/remove/reorder/tweak layers and write custom TSL shaders with a compile feedback loop.

Setup requirement: the editor must be open in a WebGPU browser with the agent bridge enabled — run the dev server and open http://localhost:3000/tools/shader-lab?agent=1. Tools fail with a clear error until a tab connects.

Layer model: layers stack like Photoshop — index 0 is the top of the sidebar and is applied LAST; the highest index is the base/background (it renders first). Effects transform the composite of every layer below them in the sidebar (higher indices). New layers land at index 0 (top). Note: a source layer with compositeMode "filter" replaces what is below it.

Custom shaders (the main event): write_custom_shader compiles TSL source and returns the exact error message on failure — iterate until `compiled: true`, then call screenshot to see the pixels. Contract: export a named `sketch` (`export const sketch = Fn(() => ...)`) returning a TSL node; NO import statements (all of three/tsl plus house utils are injected globals, along with `time` and, in effect mode, `inputTexture`). Call get_shader_api_reference before writing your first shader.

All mutations go through the editor's normal undo history, so the user can Cmd+Z anything you do.
